action_item_for_main_agent: Fix ReactQuill WYSIWYG editor React compatibility issues in admin dashboard. The editor is showing 'findDOMNode is not a function' errors which prevent proper rich text editing for posts and pages. Consider updating ReactQuill to latest version or replacing with a React 18+ compatible rich text editor.
